styleHint: Post-apocalyptic wasteland game, top-down three-quarter view pixel art, clear dark outline, readable silhouette

sprites.prompt: A scruffy human survivor seen from the front, ragged jacket, gas mask hanging at the neck, backpack
A mutant dog with patchy fur and glowing green sores, side view, hunched and hungry
A wasteland raider seen from the front, spiked shoulder pad made of a car tire, pipe weapon
Seamless tileable dry cracked dirt ground with small pebbles, top-down
Seamless tileable wall made of rusty corrugated metal sheets and bolts
A pile of broken concrete rubble with bent rebar sticking out
A small scrap diesel generator machine with a fuel can, pipes and a red warning light
Seamless tileable conveyor belt segment running left to right, dark rubber belt with metal rollers on the sides
A mutant corn plant with faintly glowing yellow-green cobs
A dented tin can of food with a faded torn label
A plastic water jug, half full of slightly murky water

_paletteRoles: Index roles are shared by all palettes: 0-7 neutral ramp dark to light, 8-10 warm accent ramp, 11-12 plant ramp, 13-14 metal ramp, 15 glow. Sprites are painted in 'paintPalette' and swapped into the others by index.
